name: linear
description: Read, search, create, and update issues, projects, cycles, comments, labels, milestones, and initiatives in Linear through the official hosted Linear MCP server. Connects over Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 by default, or via a Bearer token for headless and CI use.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write issues, projects, and cycles in Linear via the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent can manage your Linear workspace directly — creating and updating issues, organizing projects and cycles, adding comments, and tracking your team's progress. No more switching to Linear for every update. Just ask your agent what's in the current cycle, create a bug report, move tasks between projects, or check what's blocked. Everything happens through natural language, connected to your live Linear data.
defaultPrompt: Show me the issues in the current cycle and their status.
Create a new issue for this bug I found.
Help me organize my backlog into projects and milestones.
